results.title: Trump's Oklahoma rally will take place hours after gubernatorial candidates tape debate
results.description: President Donald Trump is headed to Oklahoma Thursday for a rally in Durant, just hours after gubernatorial nominees Mike Mazzei and Cyndi Munson tape their debate.
